sanskrit: parāpararahasyaṃ syāt śṛṇu tvaṃ tu hite priyeānandaṃ praṇavaṃ bījaṃ ānandarūpanṛttakampañcākṣaraṃ paraṃ brahma pavitraṃ pāvanāśanamśikāraṃ ghorava * * * * * * * * * *yakāraṃ ca sadāśaivaṃ pañcadaivādhidaivatamnakāraṃ ca makāraṃ ca śikāraṃ ca vakārakamakṣarāt praṇavaṃ mukhyaṃ akṣaraṃ jñānapūrvakampraṇavena vihīnaṃ syāt tanmantraṃ prāṇahīnakamprathamasvarasaṃyuktaṃ pañcamasvarasaṃyutamevaṃ tatpraṇavaṃ proktaṃ sarvasiddhikaraṃ śubhamlāntadīrghasvaropetaṃ māntaṃ pañcākṣaraṃ parampulliṅgaṃ syād vakāraṃ śikāraṃ strīyutaṃ bhavetṛgvedaṃ syānnakāraṃ ca yajurvedaṃ makārakamitihāsaṃ yakāraṃ ca sarvadevamayaṃ tathāṛṣisthānaṃ ca brahmaṃ ca āyudhaṃ tu tathaiva cavāyurjñānendriyaṃ caiva ityete ṣoḍaśa kramātsāvitrīṃ śaktirityuktaṃ ādhāraṃ pṛthivī tathāsthānaṃ paścimato vaktraṃ sadyojātaṃ tu brahmakamguṇāṅkane menāṃ tu ghanena catuśravoktaṃ cakrameva caprāṇavāyusamāyuktamindriyaṃ caiva gandhakamnakārākṣaramidaṃ proktaṃ makārākṣaramatha śṛṇulakṣmīśaktisamāyuktamādhāraṃ jalameva casthānamuttarato vaktraṃ vāmadevaṃ tu brahmakamguṇadravyaṃ syādapi ca cakramardhendujaṃ tathāapāne vāyurūpaṃ tu rasaṃ jñānendriyaṃ bhavet

sanskrit: makāra * * * * śikārākṣaramatha śṛṇugaurīśaktisamāyuktaṃ ādhāramagnireva casthānaṃ dakṣiṇato vaktraṃ aghoraṃ brahmameva caguṇadīptisamāyuktaṃ cakraṃ tu tryagrameva cavya * * * * * yaktaṃ jñānendriyaṃ tu rūpakamśikārākṣaramidaṃ proktaṃ vakārākṣaramatha śṛṇuambikā tu mahāśaktirvāyurādhārameva casthānaṃ tu pūrvato vaktraṃ brahmaṃ tat * * * * *guṇasparśa na saṃyuktaṃ ṣaḍagraṃ cakrameva ca* * * vāyusaṃyuktaṃ sparśaṃ jñānendriyaṃ bhavetvakārākṣaramidaṃ proktaṃ yakārākṣaramatha śṛṇuunmanīśaktisaṃyuktamādhāraṃ vyomamucyatesthānamūrdhvamukhaṃ vidyāt brahmamīśānameva caguṇaṃ caiva tu śūnyaṃ syāt prakāśaṃ candrikāmaṇeḥśabda jñānendriyaṃ caiva ityete ṣoḍaśa kramātpañcākṣaramidaṃ proktaṃ praṇavākṣaramatha śṛṇusvāhādevī mahāśaktirādhāraṃ paramaṃ padamsthānaṃ śivamukhaṃ proktaṃ brahmaṃ śivamukhaṃ bhavetnirguṇīṃ nirāmayaṃ cakraṃ prakāśaṃ śatasahasrakamityete ṣoḍaśānāṃ tu praṇavaṃ praṇave namaḥardhacandranirodhī ca nādau nādāntameva casamānāntaṃ pāśajālaṃ syānmanyante paraśśivaḥekabījaṃ mahāmantraṃ turyātītaṃ manolayamnāso mantrī na cācāryo vṛthā kliśyati karmasusuṣuptirnādasaṃyogasturyaṃ śaktisamāgataḥ

sanskrit: prāṇāyāmaṃ trayaṃ kṛtvā śāstradṛṣṭena karmaṇāśikāraṃ saṃhṛtiścaiva vakāraṃ tu tirobhavamnakāraṃ kṛtayutaṃ syānmakāraṃ tretāyugaṃ bhavetyakāra yugāntaraṃ caiva pañcākṣaramidaṃ jagatkāpālaṃ pāñcarātraṃ ca ṣaḍete samayā smṛtāḥvānaprasthayatīnāṃ tu saṃhāranyāsamucyateśikāraṃ madhyamāṅgulyā makāraṃ tu anāmikamyakāraṃ mūrdhni vinyasya vakāraṃ tu lalāṭakenakāraṃ pādayo nyasya sarvāṅge praṇavaṃ nyasetśikāraṃ liṅgaśuddhistu pañcaśuddhirvidhikramamāgniyogamidaṃ proktaṃ vāyurūpaṃ tathaiva caāvāhanaṃ nakāreṇa sthāpanaṃ tu makārakampūjayettu yakāreṇa śivaṃ paramakāraṇamnakārasya kalāḥ pañca makārasya catuṣkalāḥyakārasya kalā cāṣṭau pañcākṣarakalā nyasetyakāramātmarūpaṃ tu nakāraṃ tu tirobhavetāvāhanaṃ nakāraṃ ca makāraṃ padmamudrikāyakāraṃ liṅgamudrā ca śivamudrāṃ niyojayetśikāramūrdhvapadmaṃ tu makāraṃ kaṇṭhameva capūjayā vipulaṃ rājyaṃ agnikāryeṇa saṃpadaḥnakāraṃ pāpaharaṇaṃ makāraṃ pāpamocanampañcākṣarasamo mantro nāsti nāsti mahāmunemahādevaḥ paro bandhuriti śāstrasya niścayaḥtatpūrvo bandhakaḥ proktastatpūrve tannivārakaḥyakāramātmasaṃyuktaṃ nakāraṃ tu tirobhavam

sanskrit: rodhanaṃ jalamityuktaṃ ātmaśakti śivātmakambhagavandevadeveśa sarvajña karuṇālayapañcākṣaraṃ paraṃ mantraṃ rahasyaṃ muktidāyakamnāputrāya ca dātavyaṃ nāśiṣyāya kadācanapañcākṣaramidaṃ devī triṣu lokeṣu viśrutamyasya smaraṇamātreṇa brahmahatyā vyapohitaataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi pañcākṣaravidhikramamnakāraṃ ca makāraṃ ca śikāraṃ ca tathaiva caetat pañcākṣaraṃ devī pañca devāḥ prakīrtitāḥpṛthivyāpastathā tejo vāyurākāśameva cabrahmā? viṣṇuśca rudraśca īśvaraśca sadāśivaḥśikāraṃ rudrarūpaṃ tu vakāramīśvaraṃ tathānakāraṃ svarṇavarṇaṃ tu makāraṃ kṛṣṇavarṇakamyakāraṃ sphaṭikākāraṃ varṇabhedāḥ prakīrtitāḥśikāraṃ ghorasaṃyuktaṃ vakāraṃ puruṣaṃ smṛtamṛgvedaṃ tu nakāraṃ syāt yajurvedaṃ makārakamitihāsaṃ yakāraṃ ca sarvavedādivaibhavamoṃkāraparamaṃ devamoṃkāraṃ paramaṃ tathānakāraṃ śāntikaṃ jñeyaṃ makāraṃ pauṣṭikaṃ tathāyakāraṃ muktidaṃ caiva ekamūrtikrameṇa tupade pade japaṃ devī yo dadyāt sa vicakṣaṇaḥevaṃ pañcākṣaraṃ jñeyaṃ mantraṃ trailokyadurlabhamubhayossaṃpuṭaṃ caiva pīṭhaṃ liṅgamiti smṛtamkrameṇa pañcākṣara divyarūpaṃ smaranti daṃ gacchati jīvamuktimyakāramabhayaṃ hastaṃ nakāraṃ cāgnirūpakam

sanskrit: sthitvā tadūrdhva ānandatāṇḍavaṃ kurute śivaḥānandatāṇḍave kṛtyamātmanaḥ kurute śivaḥsaṃhāraṃ cāgnirūpe syāttirobhāvaṃ sthirāṅghrikevidhūya māyāṃ pāpaṃ ca dagdhvaṃ pā jñānanāśanamsthāpitaṃ paramātmānaṃ santataṃ śivatāṇḍavamsaptakoṭimahāraṇyaṃ saptakoṭicarācaramtāṇḍavālayamadhye tu niṣkalaṃ paradurlabhamprakaṭayasvedaṃ majjñānaṃ madbhaktānāṃ parānanepādāṅguṣṭhakaniṣṭhāntaṃ pañcākṣareṇa pūritamjānu ūru śikāraṃ ca vakāraṃ guhyadeśakamyakāraṃ tu kaṭiḥ prokto rakāraṃ pṛṣṭhabhāgakamvakāraṃ hṛdayaṃ sthānaṃ yakāraṃ stanadeśakammakāraṃ koparaṃ proktaṃ vakāraṃ maṇibandhanamḍamarustu makāraṃ ca valayaṃ praṇavo bhavetvakāraṃ taṭirityāhurnādaṃ ca nāma mantrakamtasya haste bhujaṅgastu sūkṣmapañcākṣaraṃ bhavettathācāparahastena sṛṣṭisthityantakāraṇamśikāraṃ hanudeśaṃ tu vakāraṃ cāsyadeśakamnakāraṃ sarvanetraṃ tu makāraṃ vāmanetrakambhrūmadhye praṇavaṃ caiva madhye haṃsaṃ sudīptakamdvādaśākṣaramantraṃ tu jaṭācūḍamitīritamsarvākṣaramiśrakaṃ syāt indukhaṇḍamiti smṛtamānandanṛttamamalaṃ nṛtyantaṃ niṣkalaṃ śivamnāputrāya pradātavyaṃ nāśiṣyāya tathaiva casabhāyantramidaṃ proktaṃ dakṣiṇārādhanaṃ śṛṇu

sanskrit: snapanaṃ tu samākhyātamutsavaṃ vada śaṃkarautsavaṃ saptadhā jñeyaṃ śṛṇuṣvaikāgramānasaḥarkajatviti vikhyātaṃ sannavadaṃ niśākarapañcāhaṃ brāhmakaṃ proktaṃ triyahaṃ mauktimucyatearkajanvarkavāre tu saptadhā cotsavāttvihama nta śyāmama ṣaṣṭhe pāpyarka teja ddhvajoddhṛtidhvajamāropayet pūrvaṃ uttamaṃ madhyamādhamamcitrā viśākhāmūlaṃ ca uttarāṣāḍhameva camakhā cottaranakṣatraṃ meṣādi dvādaśeṣu cakṛṣṇāṣṭamyāntaka jyeṣṭhe mākhe ṣaṣṭhyantakaṃ bhavetrājñāṃ janmalaye yuddhe yajamānasya janmanidharmārthaṃ kāmadaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ karmajaṃ māsameva hiyasmin māse tu kartavyamutsavaṃ śaśālāñchanadhvajāṅkurādi tīrthāntaṃ tasmin māse paraṃ smṛtampūrvamāse dhvajotthānaṃ tasmin caivotsavaṃ tu yatpūrvamāse pratiṣṭhāpya yāgaṃ tasmin sutīrthakamekavāstuka devānāṃ utsavānāṃ tu saṃkaramyadvāstu kalitaṃ candra tadeva dvividhaṃ bhavetprāka pādārakāsīmāt parito vaikadeśataḥprākārāntaṃ tathā brāhmyaṃ kalpita kṣudra vāstukamedhasmāttasmāttvaismātvaika vāstukaṃ * * * *tasminnaiva prakartavyaṃ sarvasiddhimabhīpsitāyaḥ kuryādanya devānāṃ dakṣiṇaṃ tīrthadānataḥsūkṣmāsi tantu suślakṣṇaṃ manoramyaṃ paṭannavatāreṇa tu samaṃ pūrvaṃ tadūrdhvaṃ śikharaṃ bhavet

sanskrit: tanmadhye vṛṣabhaṃ lāñchyaṃ sitaraktādivarṇakaiḥchatraṃ tu cāmarau kumbhaṃ * * * * likhet kramātcandanaṃ campakaṃ sālaṃ panasaṃ devadārukambilvaṃ punnāgakhadirakramukānnālikerakamdviguṇaṃ vā samaṃ vā'tha pādahīnamathārdhakamkavāṭārdhamatho hitvā śeṣamutsedhamucyatedaṇḍotsedhasya pāñcāṃśaṃ dvibhāgenaiva saṃdṛḍhamyaṣṭiṃ grāhya tadardhe tu tritālasya tu madhyametritālādhikyamagre tu dāpayeddaṇḍikātrayammadhyamāṅgulināhaṃ tu rajjuṃ kṛtvā sutantunāyaṣṭyagre kūrcasaṃyuktaṃ darbhamālāsamāvṛtaḥdhvajotthāna dināt pūrve sthāpayet dhvajadaṇḍakamniṣkaṃ tripādamardhaṃ vā pādahemārdhameva vāhṛdayena tu mantreṇa sthāpayedacalaṃ dṛḍhamvistāra samamutsedhaṃ pādahīnamathā'pi vāpaṅkajaṃ kalpayedūrdhve karṇikātālasaṃyutamtasmin dine'thavā kāryaṃ prātaḥkāle'dhivāsanamgomayālepite śubhre prokṣite tu śivāmbhasāpadmaṃ prakalpayeddhīmānāsanaṃ kalpayet kramātpaścime sthaṇḍile sthāpya candraśekharamādarātvṛṣakumbhaṃ tadagre tu dhvajaṃ tasyāgratastathāpratyekaṃ navavastreṇa * * * * dibhiryajetnayane mokṣaṇaṃ kuryāt dhvajokṣasya viśeṣataḥsukumaṃ? tantunā veṣṭya cāḍhakadvayapūritamparitaḥ kalaśānaṣṭau lokapālādhidaivatān

sanskrit: svamūlenaiva saṃpūrtistadagniṃ kalpayettataḥanyathānādikaṃ kṛtvā pañcasaṃskārasaṃskṛtāḥvṛṣamūlāṅgakairyuktaṃ juhuyāttu śatāhutiḥpañcabhirbrahmabhirjuhuyāt pūrṇa * riṃ ta sādhayetrātrāvaivaṃ prakartavyaṃ prabhāte * * * * *dhvajārohaṇa pūrvaścet dhvajenaivāhni deśikāḥyantreṇa rohayet ketuṃ vṛṣagāyatrimantrataḥsādhitaiḥ kalaśaissamyak sthāpaye * * * * laketato rātau ca kṛtvānna liṅgapūjāṃ samārabhetbherīṃ tathārcayet paścādācāryaṃ pūjayettataḥprahāreṇa tridhācāryo bherīṃ gāyatri vidyayāpādakaṃ pūjayet paścāt vādyatālavitālakāngrāmapradakṣiṇaṃ kuryāt astradevādisaṃyutamāhūyābhyarcayattena baliṃ dadyāt svamantrataḥdhvajārohaṇa pūrvaṃ tu khyātaṃ satyamayā tavākṛtvā tu ropayet ketuṃ bherītāḍana pūrvakamaṅkurārpaṇapūrvaśca bherīṃ saṃtāḍayetttataḥpūrvāhne dvija ṛddhi syāt rātrau śūdravivardhanamviśeṣāt pūjaye nitya dhvajaṃ caiva triśūlakamrathānnāṅgāṃśca śibikān sarvayantraviśeṣakānchatra piñchaviśeṣāṇi cāmaravyañjanāni cavastrānyā bharaṇāścaiva sarvapātra viśeṣakānupānāt sthūpiparyantaṃ vimānaṃ bhūṣayet kramātyatreccādeśataḥ kuryāt pariveṣe yāgamaṇṭapamprapāṃ kṛtvādi bhadrāṃśca vitānadhvajaśobhitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00273 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: puṣpasrak paṭṭadevāṅgaiḥ ghaṇṭācāmarapallavaiḥsarvālaṃkārasaṃyuktamevaṃ kṛtvā viśeṣataḥtoraṇadhvajavastraiśca kadalīkramukairapievaṃ dvārāṇi saṃbhūṣya grāmadevālayaṃ stathānimnonnata samaṃ kṛtvā saṃśodhya jalasecanamśobhitaṃ syāt patākaiśca dhvajairākāśaketubhiḥgandhamālyāṅkuraiśchatraṃ kumbhairvastraiśca chatritaḥaiśānyāṃ vahnideśe vā ṣoḍaśastambha saṃyutamdigvāratoraṇairyuktamavitānadhvaja bhūṣitamekāśīti padeṣvantarvedi syānnavabhiḥ padaiḥpūrvokta vidhinā kuṇḍaṃ kuryāttatra viśeṣataḥpañcacūrṇairalaṃkṛtya pallavādi viśobhitamkṛtvaivaṃ yāgaśālāṃ tu vanayātrārthamaṇṭapamchannaiścampakāśokasālacampaka bilvakaiḥpanasairnālikeraiśca kadalīkramukāmrakaiḥketakīmātulaṅgaiśca likucaiḥ pippalairapitrintraṇī * * * * * nimbadārukapitthakaiḥmaṇṭapaṃ madhyame kuryāt jalakrīḍāya pārśvataḥbahiḥ prākārasaṃyuktaṃ dvāragopura śobhitāmevamanyā bahūn sarvān utsavāṅgānviśeṣataḥtīrthasudinapūrve tu daśame divase niśidhātubāṇaguṇaikāhannā * * * * * kṣiṣuyāgamaṇṭapamadhye tu vedikopari deśikaḥaṣṭadroṇe tu śālīnāmūrdhve tasyārdhataṇḍulaiḥhṛnmantraṃ tu samuccārya madhyapatre tu bandhayet

sanskrit: sūtreṇāvedya kumbhāṃstu trivit sūtravicitritānvinyasya tasya vāmādyairvardhanīṃ cāpi mūlataḥratnālābhe tu hemābjaṃ vardhanyāṃ hemamutpalamgandhapuṣpādinā pūjya havirmūlena dāpayetgandhāmbupūritān sarvān arcayet svasvamantrataḥvastraiḥ pratyekamācchādya kūrcacakrakasaṃyutānvittānusārataḥ kaścit ricchāyā parikalpayetpūrvādidakṣiṇe cāpye saumye caiśānagocarecaturdikṣu pradānaṃ ca pañcāgna parikalpayetagnyādhānādikaṃ kuryāt pūrvoktena vidhānataḥnīvārajāla santāśca māṣamutgakulasthakānpriyaṅgusarṣapaṃ caiva madhudadhnā payoyutamuttamaṃ tviti vikhyātaṃ kalaṃsthaṃ taṃ tu madhyamamsamidājyau tu mūlena hṛdayena ca grastathākavacenādimāṣādīn netreṇa tu tilaṃ hunetmadhu vaktreṇa hotavyaṃ dadhi ghoreṇa homayetdaśākṣareṇa pūrvaṃ tu gāyatrī phalavaktrakamagnikāryāvidhānoktamādau kuryādviśeṣataḥsāye syādutsavārambhe prātasvāpabhṛtorbhavetastamānasya pūrve tu vāmamekaṃ tathācaretgomānte tu baliṃ dadyāddinadeva priyāpahamhomādyaṃ śāntikaṃ proktaṃ homamadhyaṃ tu pauṣṭikamannena kārayelliṅgamuttamaṃ balipātrakesaṃpūjyajyāstraṃ ca mukulaṃ padmamudrāṃ ca darśayettriśūlamannaliṅge vā na vedāstraṃ samāvṛtam

sanskrit: snapanaṃ tu tataḥ kuryāt aṣṭottaraśatena tucaṇḍeśaṃ pūjayet rātrau caṇḍagāyatrīmuccarancaṇḍāgre homamevaṃ tu caṇḍagāyatrimantrataḥvṛṣagāyatrimantreṇa dhvajamūle samarcayetvisarjayet krameṇaiva tattadvāstu vadantareapare divase caiva mūlaliṅgaṃ tu pūjayettasyānte snapanaṃ kuryāt śuddhasnānamanantaram* * * * * * * * * vajraṃ pūjayettataḥyathā vibhavavistāraṃ rājā sarvān prapūjayetāyuṣyaṃ vibhavaṃ putrān pautrān sarvān vivardhayetśivasāyujyamāpnoti śivotsava prabhāvataḥekāhameva dāhānte īśādistribhireva caathā * * * * naṃ ca kathyate peśato'dhunātasya mantramayaṃ śuddhaṃ daheddehaṃ śivāgninākiṃ tu śiṣyaistadā kāryaṃ anṛṇārthaṃ śivārcanamathātassaṃpravakṣyāmi tattvajñānanidarśanamavasthādarśanaṃ caiva arthapañcakamucyatepatijñānaṃ ca sāyujyaṃ ātmalābhaṃ tathā bhavetparāparaṃ parāśaktiḥ kuṭilotpannanādakamsadāśivotpanna īśaṃ tu śuddhavidyā tatotbhavetvaikharīvarṇamutpannaṃ varṇo mantrāstatotbhavāḥtattvaṃ sṛṣṭiṃ ca śabdeṣu śuddhatattvaṃ ca vardhatekālaṃ niyatiścotpannaṃ kalā vidyā ca rāgakaḥprakṛtyā caiva avyakte cittabuddhisamudbhavaḥtaijaso vaikharībhūtaṃ trividhaṃ nāmamucyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00273 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ahaṃkāre vaikharīyuḥ karmendriyasamudbhavaḥśabde ākāśamutpannaṃ sparśe vāyustathoditaḥgandhe mahī samudbhūta tattvakārye na ceṣṭitamsalilaṃ rasabandheṣu rūpeṇāgniṃ suyojayetśabdādi pañcatanmātraṃ rūpe'haṃkāra bandhayetjñānendriyaṃ ca pañcaite'haṃkārastaijase gatecittakṣetrajña yukteṣu pañcaviṃśatirāgakeśāstrajālaṃ ca mantrāṇi mantre varṇeṣu yojayetmadhyamā caiva paśyanti paśyantī sūkṣma yojayetśuddhavidyā śivāntāni kuṭile yojayettataḥsṛṣṭisaṃhāramevoktaṃ sthitikramamathocyatepūrvakarma * * * * * ṣṭhāgni cakravadbhramātśabdādi pañcatanmātraṃ vartate dhāmasannidhaumano buddhirahaṃkāraṃ cittaṃ caiva caturthakamātmatattvamiti khyātaṃ darśanaṃ ca tataḥ śṛṇuvidyā jñānādikaṃ caiva rā * * * * * * *māyā cittaṃ bhramaṃ kuryāt * ga kāṇḍamiti smṛtamjñānasūkṣmaṃ kriyādhikyamīśatattvamiti smṛtamśaktitattvaṃ kriyotpannaṃ śivatattvaṃ tato'dhikamsthūlaṃ sūkṣmaṃ paraṃ caiva ṣaṭtriṃśat tattvadarśanamśivatattvaṃ paraṃ caiva guruvaktre pradarśayetviśrāmyaṃ ca tadātmā ca pañcāvasthākriyodbhavāḥlalāṭe kaṇṭhahṛdaye nābhiliṅgāvasānakamśrotrādipañcakaṃ caiva śabdādi pañcakaṃ bhavetprāṇādi daśavāyuśca manādi puruṣapañcayuk
source_edition: Muktabodha M00273 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: prāṇādi vāyubhiścaiva śabdamādikaṃ daśajāgre viṣayabhogaṃ ca vāsanā snapanameva cacittaprāṇau ca kṣetranyo hṛdaye ca suṣupti hiātmaprāṇaśca kurye tu vartate nābhimūlakeliṅgamūle tu kṣetrajño turyātītannamaśyatecaturaṅgabalo mantrī rājācāntaḥparaṃ gataḥatho'vasthā ca ityevaṃ madhyāvasthā tataḥ śṛṇuathovasthā ca madhyā ca jñātvā caivaṃ vicakṣaṇaḥparāsaṃsthā iti jñeyā jāgrādīnāṃ ca bhāvayetkevalassakalo śuddho darśanaṃ ca tataśśṛṇuatītaṃ kevalāvasthā śuddhā ca smarasīyutāmāyāvasthā ca evoktaṃ jāgraddṛśyaṃ tataśśṛṇuśrotrādi ekatattvaṃ ca śabdādi ekasaṃyutamśivasannidhimātre tu ātmānaṃ vartate sadājāge dṛśyapravṛttiśca pratyāhāreṇa śāmyatisamādhinā tu turyaṃ tu turyātītaṃ śivena tuityevaṃ nirmalāvasthā arthapañcakamucyatearthapañcakamevoktaṃ pratyakṣaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ śṛṇutāmrakālīkavat kṛtvā āṇavaṃ śaktirucyatemāyā ca vasturūpāṇi cittabhrama iti smṛtāḥtanujjāraṇavijñāne mahāmāyā iti smṛtāḥdravyadṛśyātmapakvaṃ ca tirobhāva iti smṛtaḥpuṇyapāpa samāyukto śivaśaktinipātataḥdveṣyaṃ tyavasthitibhāvo śivabhakteṣu bhaktibhiḥravisannidhimātreṇa sūryakānto'gnirudbhavaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00273 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mandaṃ mandataraṃ caiva tīvraṃ tīvrataraṃ bhavetpakvāpakvaṃ caturbhedaṃ jñātvā bhedena buddhimāncaryāpādaḥ kriyāpādaḥ dāso * * vamucyateevaṃ śaivāgame mukhyaṃ pāśāt paśupatikramātbāhyabhāvaṃ manobhāvaṃ antarbhāvamiti smṛtamantarbhāvopadeśaṃ ca pāśaḥ paśupatirbhavetlayāvikārabhogaṃ ca maṇimantrauṣadhaṃ bhavettatsāraṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣvekāgramānasaḥtattvātītaṃ ca yat proktaṃ ātmajñānamitirbhavetityevaṃ trividhaṃ jñātvā sāyujyaṃ bhavati dhruvamsaptadhātumayaṃ deho hyanityaśca yathā viduḥ* * * * * tānītyā śabdādīnāṃ tu ceṣṭitamguṇatrayaṃ tato bhinnaṃ śuddhavidyā sadāśivamdehajñānendriya * * * * * guṇavāyu tamtattvādiśaktiparyantaṃ tattvāni saha bhāvayetevaṃ ṣaṭtriṃśatattvāni naśyante darśanaṃ ca yattattvātītaṃ yat jñānaṃ tatjñānaṃ parajāgrajamtatjñānaṃ vedaśāntiṃ ca suṣuptiḥ parameva capatijñānamiti proktaṃ sāyujyaṃ ca tataśśṛṇuasiśabdaṃ ca sāyujyaṃ tattvajñānamiti smṛtamsamaṃrasī bhāvamevoktaṃ mātṛbhāvamathocyatesarvacintāvinirmuktaḥ ekenaiva vivarjitamākāraṃ ca nirākāraṃ vācyavācakavarjitamśrotraṃ nāsti śrutistatra cakṣurnāsti sa paśyatijihvā nāsti rasaṃ gṛhya tvakvinā sparśanaṃ viduḥ

sanskrit: mano nāstīti saṃkalpya trailokyaṃ sacarācaramcarācaramidaṃ sarvaṃ veṣṭate bhujate sadājyotirūpaṃ paraṃ divyaṃ pralayāmbu pūritamsākṣāt śivamayaṃ kṛtvā na kiṃcidapi cintayetniṣkalaṃ śivamātattvaṃ tanmayāmāmalābhakamtaddhyānaṃ tajjapaṃ pūjā homakāryanna sādhanamsannyāsī sarvakarmāṇi śivameva tu bhāvayettiṣṭhan gacchan svapan jāgran strīsaṅge bhojane'pi cagarvakrodhamanobhāvo jñānājñāna iti bhramegurupādāt paraṃ nāsti ātmalābhāt parodayamsṛṣṭyādi ātmalābhāntaṃ daśabhedaṃ kramocyategururūpaṃ paraṃ jñānaṃ gururūpaṃ paraṃ śivamdhyānarūpo guro mūrti pūjābhāvo gurotpadamguruḥ pitā gururmātā sarvaṃ gurumayaṃ viduḥśaivarājendratatvajño śivabhāvena rājitamśāstrārthaṃ guruvākyaṃ ca svānubhūtyā samaṃ viduḥśrīmūla śivapādārthadarśanaṃ tatprabhāvataḥ
